messages:
rachel: Heads-up 10m sync1 about rollout plan for route: adaptive-hotpath. Goal: safe A/B + staged region rollouts with tenant-tier opt-ins/opt-outs. Key constraints: conversational stickiness, cost delta tracking, and enterprise dedicated schedules. Draft below, please flag holes.

dmitri: Love the outline. Propose this flow: 1) shadow for 48h with 100% traffic (no responses) to gather perf + quality deltas 2) micro-canary (0.5% internal crew) 3) public A/B 5% control vs 5% variant (even split) for 24h 4) scale by tenant-tier: PREMIUM -> STANDARD -> FREE; ramp durations: PREMIUM 48h, STANDARD 72h, FREE 7d.

sophia: Telemetry gates: collect p50/p95/p99, 10m rolling error-rate, traces sampled at 1% + 100% for errors, cost-per-request, tokens-per-response, and ML eval metrics (ROUGE/semantic-similarity on daily probe set). Add an automated quality regression check: if quality_score_drop > 3 points vs baseline for 6h -> pause ramp.

omar: Fallback policies: (a) soft fallback -> route to quantized model variant (rwd/mini-quant) keeping same session id; (b) hard fallback -> route to stable-hosted (region policy) and mark session as degraded. Circuit breaker rules: if p95 latency increases by >40% vs baseline for 10m OR error-rate >1.5% for 5m -> trigger soft fallback. Manual emergency kill in Console required.

cass: Customer/PM asks: need per-tenant feature flag + api to opt-out and an endpoint to query rollout status (which model variant + timestamp). Also prepare a short customer-facing FAQ: what to expect, how to opt-out, SLA implications. For dedicated customers, send a swimlane schedule and allow them to pick a blackout window.

rachel: On A/B specifics: use stable prompt set for 24h paired evals and run human review samples daily for first 72h. For conversational sessions keep session affinity for 24h after a fallback; if we switch models we should append an annotation header so downstream clients can surface degraded behavior.

dmitri: Infra notes: disable prefix/KV cache pre-warm during shadow and initial micro-canary to avoid cross-canary contamination. Also run a load-profile test simulating 3x normal token length for the first canary. Add rollout flag: feature.hotpath_v2 -> phased values: off -> shadow -> micro -> ab -> ramp.

sophia: Alerts: non-pager: token-cost delta >10% sustained 2h, p95 >200ms for 10m; pager: p95>300ms for 10m OR quality_score_drop >5 points for 3h. Telemetry owner: sophia.

omar: Session handling: when routing between model variants, keep KV-cache TTL short and mark messages with metadata: "x-rwd-model" header. If we downgrade, ensure streamed token truncation behavior is consistent. Also: for long-running chats, prefer sticky routing to variant unless explicit user opt-in.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2026-04-05 01:30 UTC (shadow start). CI: shadow-smoke -> micro-canary -> ab-test pipeline. Tags: adaptive-hotpath-v2-shadow. Preflight 20m before each phase.

rachel: Action items: 1) dmitri -> implement shadow-mode + feature flag lifecycles + KV prewarm toggle (reply "ack dmitri") 2) sophia -> dashboards, eval harness, alerts (reply "ack sophia") 3) omar -> fallback routing + session-affinity + x-rwd-model header (reply "ack omar") 4) cass -> customer FAQ + opt-out API + dedicated swimlane comms (reply "ack cass") 5) eng-plat -> schedule enforcement + kill-switch in Console (eng-plat: please reply)

dmitri: ack dmitri

sophia: ack sophia

omar: ack omar

cass: ack cass

rachel: Great 1'll collate and create the runbook. If anyone has vendor-specific constraints (e.g., HSM/KMS rotation windows) pls ping. We'll reconvene 15m preflight for the shadow start. :rocket:
